title: HPC Storage Extension
description: STAC HPC Storage Extension for STAC Items, describing where on an HPC facility a data file lives.

hpc:facility.title: Facility
hpc:facility.description: The HPC facility operating the system, e.g. 'AWI', 'DKRZ'.

hpc:system.title: System
hpc:system.description: The name of the HPC system, e.g. 'albedo', 'levante'.

hpc:storage_tier.title: Storage tier
hpc:storage_tier.description: Coarse-grained access-latency tier for the storage backing this file.

hpc:storage_type.title: Storage type
hpc:storage_type.description: The filesystem or storage technology backing this file, e.g. 'lustre', 'gpfs', 'hpss'.

hpc:last_access.title: Last access time
hpc:last_access.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the file's last access, as reported by the filesystem.
